svg.title: Undersea internet cables
svg.desc: A world map draws 15 submarine cables. Packets stream along them, and three journeys show the one-way light travel time: a video call from New York to Bude, a photo from Singapore to Marseille, and a game move from Tokyo to Oregon.

g.text: 15 of the 500+ cables in service, about 109,000 km in total.
